mentions.name: Yggdrasil
mentions.description: Yggdrasil is a platform that consumes and stores all of a user's LLM queries and conversations, keeping them easy to query and reference. Conversations are organized in a branching tree interface called Heimdall for discussing and planning with AI assistance before invoking its simple agent, Valkyrie. It lets users (or a developer replacing them) browse past LLM conversations, mind maps, questions asked, and explored branches as a navigable thought process, and is designed around a human + AI assistance philosophy while avoiding context pollution.
mentions.problem: LLM front ends have terrible native branching features, and users risk context pollution and over-dependence on LLM-assisted coding; Yggdrasil bets on human + AI assistance instead of agents/AI doing everything.
mentions.audience: Developers who use LLMs for coding assistance, planning, and exploratory learning
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been building https://github.com/zayr0-9/Yggdrasil

It started as a solution to LLM front ends having terrible native branching features. But slowly I realize most of our data will be going through LLM's so Yggdrasil is evolving into a platform which consumes all your LLM queries, while keeping it easy to query and reference.
